2.why: Basic decimal operations are routine for my age and education level without much anxiety.

3.why: Geometry concepts from secondary school remain accessible even if I do not study them actively.

4.why: Algebra requires focus which my low conscientiousness might make difficult during high pressure situations.

5.why: Trigonometry is complex and rarely used in daily life so my confidence remains quite low here.

6.why: Calculating area and volume feels manageable but I hesitate to attempt it under exam conditions.

9.why: Finding missing side lengths is standard curriculum material but my confidence fluctuates based on time pressure.

1.why: I am agnostic and open-minded, seeing math as just a tool. My high openness score means I view it without fear.

2.why: Some nervousness about performance but mostly confident given my chemistry background which involves calculations regularly.

3.why: Algebra triggers anxiety since literature and economics are subjects I prefer over math related topics significantly.

4.why: Homework due soon creates pressure but my high extraversion helps me engage with social aspects of class.

5.why: Low conscientiousness means I do not stress about starting new chapters unless it directly impacts my work life.

6.why: Lectures are okay because I prefer travel and birdwatching so I learn best through varied experiences not textbooks.

7.why: Hearing explanations helps me understand concepts better without feeling anxious since chemistry interests me deeply.

8.why: Pop quizzes cause moderate anxiety because they interrupt my relaxed lifestyle focused on hobbies like traveling abroad.

9.why: Starting new chapters is manageable since I enjoyed art and science subjects during my upper secondary education.

1.why: I have always enjoyed mathematics as a subject and feel confident in my abilities to learn and perform well without stress or worry.

2.why: Mathematics comes naturally to me and I don't doubt my capacity to solve problems or understand mathematical concepts effectively.

3.why: I can easily grasp new mathematical ideas and learn the material required for any course with confidence and ease.

4.why: I expect to succeed in future mathematics courses because I have always had good grades and enjoy learning.

5.why: The content of mathematics courses is clear to me and I feel capable of understanding complex topics without difficulty.

6.why: I consistently achieve high marks in mathematics and believe I can easily get an A on any assignment or exam.

7.why: Solving mathematical problems is something I excel at and feel confident doing in any course setting without hesitation.

8.why: I never worry about test performance because I have strong skills and always prepare well for mathematics examinations.

9.why: Preparing for a test is a normal study activity that I approach calmly without any feelings of tension or anxiety.

10.why: Taking tests in mathematics feels calm and focused rather than nervous or stressful to me personally.

11.why: I have the skills to achieve top grades so getting an A is a realistic expectation for my performance.

12.why: I am confident I will get good grades because I understand the material well and study effectively.

13.why: I feel calm and confident during tests because I trust my knowledge and ability to handle any question.

14.why: I believe I can perform well on tests since I am a strong learner in mathematics subjects.

15.why: Homework assignments are enjoyable tasks for me and do not create stress or pressure when I work on them.

16.why: Sometimes using math outside school feels slightly challenging but I don't get nervous about real-world applications much.

17.why: I feel confident applying mathematics to real world situations like travel planning or birdwatching gear calculations without worry.

18.why: I do worry a little about using math in my future career but I think I will learn what is needed.

19.why: I rarely worry about understanding mathematical concepts because I have strong analytical skills from my science background.

20.why: I can learn mathematics well and enjoy the process of mastering new topics in any course.

21.why: Listening to instructors sometimes feels a bit intense but overall I remain engaged and confident during lectures.

22.why: I am confident I will use mathematics in my career as it helps me with various professional tasks effectively.

23.why: I worry slightly about future courses knowing enough math but I trust my ability to learn quickly if needed.

24.why: I never fear giving wrong answers because I am confident in my knowledge and think quickly during class.

25.why: I feel very confident asking questions when I don't understand something in my mathematics classes.

26.why: Asking questions can be slightly uncomfortable but I try to overcome the nervousness by focusing on learning.

27.why: Completing all assignments is easy for me since I stay organized and understand the required work well.

28.why: I rarely worry about completing every assignment because I manage my time effectively and find tasks manageable.
